description: Dati da sensore della stazione smt21 - Via emilia -Viale Rimembranze -Piazzale Risorgimento - Canal Chiaro is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Emilia Romagna. Osservazioni riguardanti le misurazioni della velocità e della numerosità dei veicoli rilevate dai sensori radar nell'incrocio Via Rimembranze e Viale Canal Chiaro. I veicoli presi in considerazione sono: pedoni, bici, moto, auto, pickup, camion lunghi, camion corti. Il csv, per il quale è possibile fare il download, contiene 100 osservazioni. Coverage: Regione Emilia Romagna. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Emilia Romagna. Its tags are corso-cana-chiaro, piazzale-risorgimento, sensori, smt21, traffico. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
